title: SpaceX catches upper stage of Starship rocket in historic first
summary: SpaceX achieved a significant milestone with the successful catch of the upper stage of the Starship rocket during Test Flight 15. This event marked a historic first for Elon Musk's aerospace company, which had previously focused on catching the booster stage. The dual catch of both rocket stages demonstrates advancements in reusable rocket technology and highlights SpaceX's commitment to innovation in space travel.
